Full details are in the Release. **Current version: [2.1.6](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/tag/v2.1.6)** · [Full bilingual update](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_2.1.6.md). ## New in 2.1.2 - **SR:** true dual RTX Video SR with separate second-pass controls, plus SR-then-downsample; ordinary 8K retained, new graphs check VRAM budget. - **GPU options:** NVIDIA Low Latency Off / On / On + Boost; experimental RX 7000 RedDuke NR, Small/Original and per-layer scale; separate RX 9000 path retained. - **FG:** sparse-noise-tolerant full-frame dedup, remove coarse generated-frame discard, smoothed anchors, optional VFG regulation, adaptive VSync capacity wait capped at 3 ms. - **Capture/audio:** WGC high-refresh cadence, ready-immediate no-FG capture, first-copy 60→30, Dolby/DTS carriers on generic PCM pins. - **Controls:** F7 screenshot / F8 recording in game mode too; Cinema volume dragging, endpoints, Enter/click-away confirmation and focus. [All changes since 2.1.1, measurements and migration](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_2.1.2.md) · [Build and corresponding source](docs/BUILD_2.1.2.md). ## New in 2.1.1 - **Interface and SR defaults:** software UI drawing by default, an optional GPU renderer with restart confirmation, and RTX Video SR high as the new SR model selection; saved model choices are retained. - **Record and rotate:** record the processed picture with player audio; rotate playback90° in Cinema/Professional with matching preview and window layout. - **NR sizing:** per-layer25–100% scale controls, saved presets/sessions and fixed/percentage video-export inference sizes with independent output resolution. - **Display and frame generation:** background event-driven refresh/VRR/HDR queries, shared signal-panel refresh and HDR-cache recovery. - **Enhancement:** correct AMD FSR-off state, native-HDR NR proxy/reconstruction and List-mode AA placement after NR. - **Interaction and lifecycle:** popup first-open layout, real screenshot paths/formats, fullscreen/maximized restoration, playlist key ownership, capture preparation timestamps and NR/NVAPI teardown. [Full2.1.1 update](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_2.1.1.md) · [Build and corresponding source](docs/BUILD_2.1.1.md). ## New in 2.1.0 - **AMD NR0.44:** RX9000 Small/Original models via the per-layer performance switch(default on), saved in presets/sessions/export; explicit asset errors, no new RX6000/7000 support. - **Anti-aliasing:** independent FXAA/SMAA/MLAA, List/Nodes, quality/strength controls, HDR and List export; experimental temporal SMAA defaults off. - **Beauty and original-face restoration:** separate switches, up to six layers,468-point contours, eye/brow/lip exclusion, per-frame detection and smoothing; restoration mixes the pre-effect source back into faces. - **Capture modes:** native enumeration fallback, driver ranges/steps/custom-size checks, searchable legacy list, exact rate/pixel-format matching, explicit substitution rejection, saved/resumed capture settings. - **Network and AVerMedia audio:** shared buffering/reconnect, slow-server buffering status, HLS/interlaced damage handling, throttled subtitle scanning; vendor multichannel audio, non-PCM confirmation, complete-payload decode and bounded recovery. - **Other fixes:** game-mode handoff/hotkeys/scaling/static resize, fullscreen transport/cursor, disabled-node order and export protocol consistency, home/sponsor page, corrected Bilibili profile and complete new translations. [Complete2.0.9→2.1.0 update, instructions and validation limits](docs/history/releases/RELEASE_NOTES_2.1.0.md). The exact user-tested packages are promoted without rebuilding/repacking; internal2.1.0-test labels/manifests remain, PE2.1.0.0. ## Install and upgrade Download **Veyra-2.1.6-NVIDIA-win64-portable.zip** or **Veyra-2.1.6-AMD-win64-portable.zip** for Veyra's active GPU. Extract with Windows or 7-Zip into a new writable folder and run **veyra_qml_ui.exe**. You need one GPU package to run the application; source assets are only for rebuilding. Windows 11 x64 and DirectX 12 are required; Qt and approved runtimes are included, while GPU/capture drivers are installed separately. Backend hardware requirements vary; most local tests used an RTX 5070. Start with effects off, check picture/sound, then enable effects individually. High resolution, layered NR and frame generation increase GPU/VRAM requirements. **The 1.4.4 UI guide is obsolete.** Version 2.0 uses separate settings. Retain the old version for rollback; do not overwrite the new package with old `veyra.ini`, an entire `runtime_local` folder or mixed DLLs. **Upgrade 2.1.1→2.1.2:** prefer extracting into a new folder; copy only `runtime_local/user-data-2.0.0` and custom `runtime_local/luts` after closing Veyra. Use Settings→About for custom paths. Same-flavour in-place overlay is possible after exit but leaves stale components. [Steps](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_2.1.2.md#升级并保留设置). **Historical 2.1.0→2.1.1 migration:** close Veyra and back up user data first. Overlay the matching GPU package contents into the existing executable directory to retain its data folder. For a new installation directory on the same PC, open Settings→About→User data in the old version, then close it and copy its `user-data-2.0.0` folder into the new package’s `runtime_local` directory. Copy only the data folder to keep the new runtime files; custom data-directory launches

# Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for [GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance) and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. [**Modern Web Guidance**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/modern-web-guidance) is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and [GOVERNANCE.md](./GOVERNANCE.md) for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. --- *Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community.* [Documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/modern-web-guidance) · [Eval Dashboard](https://googlechrome.github.io/modern-web-guidance-src/) · [Source Code](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src) · [Report an Issue](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src/issues) ## Quickstart ```shell npx modern-web-guidance@latest install ``` This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See [Alternative Installation Methods](#-alternative-installation-methods) below. #### Try it out (without installing) ```shell # Search for relevant guides npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop" # Retrieve a guide by ID npx modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "animate-to-from-top-layer" # Scan a codebase for legacy patterns to modernize npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan . ``` ## Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solutions. Even if a model knows an API exists, it often lacks the density of real-world, modern implementation patterns required for production-ready code. **Modern Web Guidance bridges this gap.** Our skill's CLI returns targeted, expert-curated guidelines directly into your agent's context window, focusing on: * **Modern Browser APIs**: Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse. * **Performance & Accessibility**: Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility affordances. * **Responsible Fallbacks**: Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries. ## What's Included? We cover the past several years of the web platform's new features, all the way up to the cutting edge. The guides are **designed to be token-efficient**; we run evals enabling us to prune lowest-common-denominator content that models already know. ### Core Disciplines

🎨 User Experience

Smooth visual states (View Transitions, entry/exit animations, parallax scroll, CSS scrollbar-color).

📐 CSS Layout

Modern layout systems (container queries, subgrid, modern color spaces like oklch, text-wrap tuning, and line-height trimming).

⚡ Performance

Speed optimizations (instant preloading, Interaction to Next Paint (INP) diagnostics, and scheduling tasks via scheduler.yield).

📝 Forms & UI

Native components (Anchor Positioning for tooltips, Popover API, dialogs, :user-invalid validation, and auto-sizing fields).

♿ Accessibility

Important considerations (screen reader and keyboard operability, content navigation and discoverability).

🤖 Built-in AI

Local client models (native translation, summarization, and language detection APIs).

HyperFrames is a free, open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows. The [HyperFrames Studio app](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/studio-app) is free to use as well; its [Pro plan](https://hyperframes.studio/pricing) adds HeyGen's top video, image, voice and music models. Using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent? Run `npx hyperframes skills update` once, then ask your agent to make a video. ## Quick Start ### With an AI coding agent For Claude Code, install the versioned plugin: ```bash claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes ``` To enable auto-update for the **hyperframes** marketplace, run `claude` in a terminal in your project. In Claude Code's terminal UI, run `/plugin`, then select **Marketplaces** → **hyperframes** → **Enable auto-update**. Afterward, use `/hyperframes:hyperframes`. See the [plugin guide](docs/guides/plugins.mdx) for Copilot, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, updates, and migration. For standalone skills (including OpenCode), use: ```bash npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes ``` > The picker opens with nothing pre-selected — the **Core Skills** group is all you need; `/slideshow`, `/remotion-to-hyperframes` and `/figma` install on demand. Without the picker (a script or a CI job), `npx hyperframes skills update` installs exactly the core set, whereas `skills add --all` installs all 9 published skills. The six repo-internal skills under `.claude/skills` / `.agents/skills` are excluded by default. For the full published set use `npx hyperframes skills`. > > `skills add` resolves the skills.sh registry blob, which can lag `main` by hours. `npx hyperframes skills update` installs the skills from the release tag that matches your CLI version, so they match the CLI that runs them. Run project-local installs from your video project's directory. From a HyperFrames checkout, use `npx hyperframes skills update` for a global install instead: a project-local installer target can overlap the tracked `skills/` source and overwrite uncommitted edits. See [contributor setup](CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-started). Try a prompt like: > Using `/hyperframes`, create a 10-second product intro with a fade-in title, a background video, and subtle background music. The skills teach agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render. They work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, IBM Bob, and other coding agents that support skills. ## Skills HyperFrames ships 9 skills. Make any video by asking for it; the `/hyperframes` skill carries the contract and the references (film, captions, overlays, motion, look). Read it first. For standalone installation, default to the **core set** (`/hyperframes`, `/hyperframes-cli`, `/hyperframes-registry`, `/media-use`, `/reverse-any-video`, `/style-sampling`). `npx hyperframes skills update` installs exactly that from anywhere; the interactive picker (`npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`) lists it as the "Core Skills" group, nothing pre-selected. The picker is interactive-only — a non-interactive or agent run without `--skill` installs all 9. Use `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --all` to install the complete published set deliberately (skips the picker), or `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill ` for just one (bare name, no leading `/`). Standalone installs stay lean after that: `npx hyperframes init` installs the **core set** only when it is missing and never touches a skill you already have (`npx hyperframes skills update` refreshes them, and never removes one); `/figma`, `/slideshow` and `/remotion-to-hyperframes` install **on demand** with `npx hyperframes skills update `. Nothing re-pulls the full set behind your back. ### Plugin packages Plugins bundle the full skill catalog and use their agent's update manager. `bun run package:agent-plugin` builds the committed portable ZIP, source metadata, and SHA-256 checksum. See the [maintainer checklist](docs/contributing/agent-plugins.mdx). ### Upload to Codex Build the upload-ready Codex plugin archive from the committed `HEAD` version of the manifest, brand assets, and skills: ```bash bun run package:codex-plugin ``` This writes `dist/hyperframes-plugin.zip` with a `hyperframes/` root folder and fails if the archive exceeds Codex's 100 MB upload limit. ### Core set | Skill | Use when | | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `/hyperframes` | **Read first** for any request to make, edit, animate or render a video, motion graphic, captions or overlays with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video). details.readme:
# f(t)

![f(t)：每一帧都是时间 t 的函数。时间轴匀速流过 t 的竖线，右边依次写出：时间的函数、自由软件、自由视频、GPL-3.0、人人共享、各尽所能](docs/media/ft.gif)

**自由软件，自由视频。** f(t) 用大语言模型协助制作讲清楚一件事的科普与项目介绍视频，并公开每部片子的事实依据、文案、审稿记录、动画源码与制作工具，以 GPL-3.0-or-later 发布。任何人都可以看、研究、修改，也可以拿去重新做一部。

名字来自画面本身：每一帧都是时间 t 的纯函数 f(t)。成片为 1920×1080、60 帧/秒，发布在 [哔哩哔哩](https://space.bilibili.com/68328330) 与 [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@waterrun1978)。全部作品、制作状态与发布记录见 **[片单](videos/README.md)**。

## 宗旨

知识是人类共同创造的财富，讲解知识的视频也应当像自由软件一样自由。每部片子连同它的全部源码一起发布，使用者享有四项自由：

| 自由 | 在 f(t) 里的含义 |
|---|---|
| 运行 | 任何人都可以为任何目的观看、放映、使用这些视频 |
| 研究 | 每一帧都是 f(t)，每一句旁白都有出处，每一个数字都能回到实验里重算 |
| 修改 | 改一句文案、换一种配色、纠正一个事实，然后重新出片 |
| 分发 | 原样或修改后再发布；分发改编作品时，按 GPL 一并提供源码 |

**以共产主义精神协作。** 知识共享，生产资料公开，各尽所能，劳动如实署名，改进回到公共。工具、方法和失败的教训都写下来，成为下一部片子的起点。人用本人选择的署名，模型写准确的型号；分工按实际贡献记录，不漏记，不冒领。

**内容大于形式。** 事实可靠、解释清楚、叙事连贯，比形式复杂更重要。画面、声音与技术为理解服务，好的文档让下一位参与者读得懂、查得了、接得上。

**开源是交付的一部分。** 自制、委托第三方或外部协作，都要交付可编辑源码、制作步骤与相应许可，不能只交一个 MP4。范围与交付方式见[开源交付与第三方许可](docs/reference/third-party.md)，完整的宗旨见[宗旨与原则](docs/principles.md)。

## 一部片子怎样做出来

1. **取证与文案。** 画面与旁白里的每一项事实都记在本片的 `research/FACTS.md`，能回到一手来源或实验。先写能通读的讲述，再拆字幕、安排镜头。
2. **本地审片页。** 文案初稿、5 个配音候选、3 个配乐小样和几个视觉方向的关键帧，放进一张本地 HTML 页面，策划者在一处看完、一次选定。
3. **确认后配音。** 文案经校对者明确确认才合成旁白。旁白逐句合成，取回每个词被读到的时刻；动画挂在「某句里的某个词」上，文案一改，画面自动重排。
4. **预览迭代。** 每一轮交出之前，制作方先做自对抗审查：把自己当成挑剔的观众和找茬的测试者，找出并修掉线压字、字被裁、名词没解释、读音不对这类问题。策划者的时间用来判断内容与审美，不浪费在简单的 Bug 上。
5. **正式片与发布。** 策划者同意后出正式片。发布后源码冻结，反馈提炼成经验规则，用在下一部。

技术上，每部视频是一段以 t 为唯一输入的 HTML 动画，不用 CSS 动画、定时器与回调；任意一帧都能独立渲染，多个无头浏览器并行出帧，再由 ffmpeg 编码封装。配乐与音效由程序合成，混音是确定性的。工具检查版面、规格与确定性；内容是否可靠、叙事是否清楚、声音是否合适，仍靠读稿、观看和试听判断。详见[制作周期](docs/process.md)。

## 仓库的结构

| 路径 | 层级 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/` | 仓库 | 宗旨、角色、制作周期、质量标准、经验规则、专题与参考，入口是[文档地图](docs/README.md) |
| `kit/` | 仓库 | 引擎、工具、新片模板、系列起点、回归测试 |
| `videos/<系列>/README.md` | 系列 | 每个系列一份说明：定位与共同约定 |
| `videos/<系列>/<片>/`、`videos/standalone/<片>/` | 视频 | 每部片子一个目录：简报、事实、文案、审稿、源码与交付记录 |

片单的唯一来源是 `videos/catalog.json`，[片单索引](videos/README.md)与 [Credit 盘点](videos/CREDITS.md)由工具生成。模型在这里工作，先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

## 快速开始

需要 Git 与 Node.js 22.12 或更新；看画面另需 Chrome 与字体。下面的命令不调用在线配音，也不改动任何影片：

```bash
npm ci
npm test
npm run check:repo
npm run assets -- --fetch
npm run doctor -- --visual
npm run smoke
```

新建一部视频：

```bash
node kit/tools/new.js <片> --title "中文标题" --title-en "English title"
node kit/tools/new.js <片> --series <系列>          # 系列里的一集；片单里已有的条目取片单的标题
```

之后的步骤见[快速入门](docs/getting-started.md)与[制作周期](docs/process.md)。独立 fork 时，在 `kit/studio.json` 填写自己的策划、校对者与源码仓库。

## 友链

- [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) — 技术交流社区

## 许可

版权所有 © 2026 WaterRun。以 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版或（由使用者选择的）任何更新的版本发布，全文见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。本仓库不提供任何担保。

第三方组件（GSAP、字体、ffmpeg、在线语音服务等）不随仓库分发，各自适用自己的许可，见[第三方组件与许可](docs/reference/third-party.md)。参与方式见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

details.readme:
Speech synthesis, speech recognition, voice activity detection and speaker diarization for voice conversation, in C++ on ggml

Models · Install · Quick start · Documentation · C API

English · 日本語

speech.cpp is one command, `speech`, and one shared library, `libspeech`, behind one C API, on the CPU, Metal and Vulkan through [ggml](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml). The command speaks text, writes the text of recordings, finds where someone speaks in them, removes their noise, transcribes the microphone as someone speaks (`speech asr --live`), serves OpenAI's audio API and its Realtime transcription over HTTP, and runs a worker process for any program that keeps models loaded between requests, [ASIST](https://github.com/nyosegawa/asist) among them. **A time to first audio of a quarter of a second or less.** On an Apple M5, Qwen3-TTS 0.6B sends its first audio 0.029 s after the text and Irodori-TTS v4.1-Small-MF 0.16 s after it, and the rest follows while it plays. **One executable, nothing else to install.** No Python and no CUDA: `speech` fetches each model by name, one GGUF file with its codec, and runs it on Metal, Vulkan or the CPU. **OpenAI's API on your own computer.** `speech serve` answers OpenAI's audio API and its Realtime transcription, so an OpenAI client works by changing its base URL. **Checked against the official implementations.** Every stage of every model is compared with the model's official implementation, from the same inputs.


The page of speech serve --open: pick a model of the catalog, fetch it and try it.


Transcribe writes a file or a recording, a region at a time where someone speaks.
Live writes the microphone as you speak; the grey text is the utterance still being said.
## Models | Task | Name | Languages | Good at | |---|---|---|---| | Synthesis | [`qwen3-tts-0.6b`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice-GGUF), [`qwen3-tts-1.7b`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice-GGUF) | de en es fr it ja ko pt ru zh | nine named speakers; audio that streams from its first frame of 0.08 s; the 1.7B model follows an instruction of how to speak | | Synthesis | [`irodori-tts-mf`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small-MF-GGUF), [`irodori-tts`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small-GGUF), [`irodori-tts-large`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Irodori-TTS-v4-Large-GGUF) | ja | Japanese in the voice of a reference recording, or in a voice described in words; the large model follows both more closely | | Synthesis | [`drama-3`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/drama-3-GGUF) | 83 languages | a scene of up to 16 speakers, with cues such as laughter written in the text, in voices cloned from recordings and their words; a 20.8 GB file. Built with Fish Audio | | Recognition | [`qwen3-asr-0.6b`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B-GGUF), [`qwen3-asr-1.7b`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-GGUF) | 30 languages | finds the language itself, takes a prompt of names and terms, and up to 20 minutes at once | | Recognition | [`reazonspeech-v2`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/reazonspeech-nemo-v2-GGUF) | ja | Japanese with punctuation, in recordings of many minutes | | Recognition | [`parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja-GGUF) | ja | short Japanese utterances, fast, with times | | Recognition | [`parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-GGUF) | 25 European languages | finds the language itself, with punctuation, capitals and times | | Recognition | [`haas-ja-v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Haas-ja-v1.0-GGUF) | ja | Japanese with punctuation, fast, with times or a custom vocabulary | | Recognition | [`nemotron-3.5-transcribe`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-GGUF) | 40 languages | word for word as spoken, fillers included, up to an hour at once, with a prompt of names and terms, or with who speaks and each word's time; a 19.0 GB file | | Detection | [`silero-vad`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/silero-vad-GGUF) | any | where someone speaks, to give a recognizer one utterance at a time; 1.2 MB | | Diarization | [`nemotron-3-diarization`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/Nemotron-3-Diarization-GGUF) | any | who speaks when, up to eight speakers, in a recording or as it arrives; 106 MB | | Enhancement | [`re-use`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE-GGUF), [`re-use-laughter`](https://huggingface.co/sakasegawa/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE-laughter-GGUF) | any | removes noise, reverberation and band limits from a recording at 8 to 48 kHz, for people to listen to; the laughter model keeps laughter; 38.5 MB | A command takes a model by its name and fetches its converted file from Hugging Face, from the repository the name links to, the first time. [docs/models.md](docs/models.md) lists the models with their sizes, voices and languages, and each family has a page: [Qwen3-TTS](docs/models/qwen3-tts.md), [Irodori-TTS](docs/models/irodori-tts.md), [Drama 3](docs/models/drama3.md), [FastConformer](docs/models/fastconformer.md), [Qwen3-ASR](docs/models/qwen3-asr.md), [Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe](docs/models/nemotron-transcribe.md), [Silero VAD](docs/models/silero-vad.md), [Sortformer](docs/models/sortformer.md) and [SEMamba](docs/models/semamba.md). ## Install macOS on Apple silicon and Linux on x86-64: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyosegawa/speech.cpp/main/install.sh | sh ``` Windows x64, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyosegawa/speech.cpp/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` The installer checks the release's archive against its SHA-256, puts `speech` under your home folder, and adds it to `PATH`. `speech update`, or running it again, updates it. On Linux it installs the Vulkan build when the Vulkan loader is installed, and the CPU build otherwise; the Linux builds need glibc 2.34 or later. [docs/install.md](docs/install.md) has the options, how to uninstall, and what each platform needs. On an Intel Mac or another system, [build from source](docs/install.md#build-from-source). ## Quick start 1. Speak a sentence. The model is fetched the first time (1.21 GB): ```sh speech tts qwen3-tts-0.6b --voice ryan -o hello.wav "Hello. It will be sunny in Tokyo tomorrow." ``` 2. Write its text back (0.84 GB the first time): ```sh speech asr qwen3-asr-0.6b hello.wav ``` ``` Hello, it will be sunny in Tokyo tomorrow. ``` 3. Open a page on which to pick models, speak and transcribe: ```sh speech serve --open ``` `speech models` lists every model and, for each language, the model to start with. ## Command line | Subcommand | What it does | |---|---| | `speech tts` | speaks text into a WAVE file or to stdout | | `speech asr` | writes the text of WAVE files, or of the microphone as someone speaks | | `speech vad` | writes where someone speaks in WAVE files | | `speech diarize` | writes who speaks where in WAVE files | | `speech enhance` | removes noise and other degradations from WAVE files | | `speech talk` | holds a conversation through the microphone with a model that listens and speaks at once | | `speech voice` | makes a voice file for Irodori-TTS or Drama 3 from reference recordings | | `speech info` | prints what a model file says of its model | | `speech devices` | lists the devices a model can run on | | `speech models`, `pull`, `rm` | list, fetch and remove models | | `speech quantize` | writes a model file of F32 weights in F16, Q8_0 or a smaller type | | `speech update` | installs the latest release, or says whether one is out | | `speech serve` | serves models over HTTP with OpenAI's audio API, and a page to try them | | `speech worker` | serves a model over JSON Lines on stdin and stdout, for programs | ```sh speech voice irodori-tts-mf me.wav me.voice.gguf speech tts irodori-tts-mf --add-voice me=me.voice.gguf --voice me -o - < story.txt | ffplay -nodisp -autoexit - speech asr reazonspeech-v2 --timestamps meeting.wav speech asr qwen3-asr-1.7b --language ja --prompt "Claude Code、渋谷" meeting.wav speech asr nemotron-3.5-transcribe --speakers meeting.wav speech asr reazonspeech-v2 --vad silero-vad --live speech vad silero-vad --max-speech-duration-s 10 meeting.wav speech enhance re-use street.wav -o clean.wav ``` Every request option is a flag, and `speech info MODEL` lists the ones a model takes. [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md) lists every subcommand and option. ## Server and page `speech serve` holds a synthesis model, a recognition model, a detection model and a diarization model, and answers `POST /v1/audio/speech` and `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` as OpenAI's audio API does, with the speakers of `diarized_json`, for a web app, a script or curl: ```sh speech serve qwen3-tts-0.6b qwen3-asr-0.6b curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/audio/speech -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"input": "Hello.", "voice": "ryan"}' -o hello.wav curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/audio/transcriptions -F file=@hello.wav ``` It listens on 127.0.0.1 and has no authentication. [docs/server.md](docs/server.md) has the endpoints, the formats, the errors and the page. ## Using the library A program links `libspeech` and includes `speech.h`, from a release archive: ```c speech_model * model = NULL; speech_request * request = NULL; speech_model_load("Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice-Q8_0.gguf", NULL, &model); speech_request_new(model, &request); speech_request_set_text(request, "Hello."); speech_request_set_string(request, SPEECH_OPT_VOICE, "ryan"); speech_synthesize(request, on_audio, NULL); /* on_audio receives the samples as they are made */ ``` Each call returns a status whose category says what failed. [docs/c-api.md](docs/c-api.md) has the whole API. A program that would rather not link a library starts `speech worker MODEL` and speaks JSON Lines with it, as ASIST do

## README 🌍 - [ [中文](./README.md) | [English](./README_EN.md) | [日本語](./README_JA.md) | [한국어](./README_KO.md) | [Deutsch](./README_DE.md) | [Português](./README_PT.md) ] ## 概述 📢 - [LinguaGacha](https://github.com/neavo/LinguaGacha) (/ˈlɪŋɡwə ˈɡɑːtʃə/)，翻译特化的次世代 `AGENT Harness` - `一键` - 各语言全自动一键互译 - 拖进去，点开始，等熟肉 - 无需任何技术背景，无需任何语言知识 - `高质量` - 不受模型审查限制，自由输出 - 自动生成术语表，保证专有名词在整部作品中的统一 - 完美保留各种 `字幕` `电子书` `游戏引擎` 的样式效果 - 语义化智能审校，只管指出问题，AGENT 自动帮你修正与润色 - `全格式` - 万物皆可译，包括但不限于： - 音频与视频 - `ASMR` `动画` `影视剧` `动态漫画` 等形式 - 字幕与电子书 - `.txt` `.md` `.epub` `.pdf` `.srt` `.ass` `.ssa` `.vtt` `.lrc` 等格式 - 游戏引擎与数据文件 - `Godot` `ACTION GAME MAKER` `RenPy` `Tyrano` `WOLFRPG` `RPGMAKER` `KV-JSON` `Message-JSON` 等引擎与数据 > > ## 特别说明 ⚠️ - 如您在翻译过程中使用了 [LinguaGacha](https://github.com/neavo/LinguaGacha) ，请在作品信息或发布页面的显要位置进行说明！ - 如您的项目涉及任何商业行为或者商业收益，在使用 [LinguaGacha](https://github.com/neavo/LinguaGacha) 前，请先与作者联系以获得授权！ ## 效果展示 ✨

details.readme:
## Thunder Engine

Thunder Engine is free for all purposes an open-source multi-functional lightweight game engine for creating 2D and 3D games.
It provides a basic framework and extensible tools.
So developers can focus on the creation, and the Thunder Engine will do the routine.

#### Status

![Build Status](https://github.com/thunder-engine/thunder/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg)
[![Codacy Badge](https://app.codacy.com/project/badge/Grade/8874a5f2ddb84eb1bbaebe00f5562c23)](https://www.codacy.com/gh/thunder-engine/thunder/dashboard?utm_source=github.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=thunder-engine/thunder&utm_campaign=Badge_Grade)
[![Translation Status](https://hosted.weblate.org/widgets/thunder-engine/-/editor-translation/svg-badge.svg)](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/thunder-engine/)
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/thunder-engine/thunder/total.svg)](https://github.com/thunder-engine/thunder/releases)

### Attention

This engine still in the development and stuff **will break**.
If this happens, the first thing to do is clear your project's cache directory and restart the editor.
If this doesnt helped please raise an issue.
Remember, by reporting problems or asking questions in public, you are **helping other people**!

### About

The main ideology of project is to create the modular engine.
It will give developers an ability to exclude modules which they are not using in their project to keep their projects lightweight.
API of Thunder Engine is also allowing to create own modules to use them in your games or in game editor.

![Screenshot of Thunder Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thunder-engine/thunder/master/doc/media/ScreenShot01.png)

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/466924817359175681.svg?logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/k8qsJxnw4Q)

### Getting the Engine

To download the release version use the [Releases page](https://github.com/thunder-engine/thunder/releases).
For other options please follow a [build instruction](https://docs.thunderengine.org/basics/install.html#building-engine-from-the-source).

### Signed Releases for Windows

Windows binaries are using free code signing provided by
[SignPath.io](https://signpath.io),
and a free code signing certificate by the
[SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/terms).

#### Features

- Cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, tvOS)
- Rendering System Based on Physical Principles
- Scripts supported by AngelScript engine
- Module based architecture

Please find a complete [list of features](https://docs.thunderengine.org/basics/features.html).

#### Have a question or an idea?

I'm always open to new ideas and you can always ask a question or you can [create a ticket](https://github.com/thunder-engine/thunder/issues/new/choose).

#### Contributing

Would like to help to project? Please read [this](CONTRIBUTING.md).
